name: com.n2o.so101-arm
description: SO-101 5-DOF arm 3D model (meshes/prefab) for the n2o Unity simulation backend. Hardware-owned counterpart to ../mjcf/ (the MuJoCo model of the same arm), meant to be imported into a Unity project as a local package -- see this folder's own README.md, and src/n2o/robot/simulation/unity/csharp/README.md for the two automated engines that pull from ../mjcf/ directly instead of needing this package finished by hand.
